description: This file contains functions and types for managing session maintenance configurations, including resolving settings, pruning stale entries, capping entry count, and rotating session files.

classes.name: SessionMaintenanceWarning
classes.description: Type representing a warning about session maintenance status, including whether pruning or capping is needed.

classes.name: ResolvedSessionMaintenanceConfig
classes.description: Type representing the resolved configuration for session maintenance, including thresholds and modes.

methods.name: resolvePruneAfterMs
methods.description: Resolves the prune after duration in milliseconds from maintenance config.

methods.name: resolveRotateBytes
methods.description: Resolves the byte size threshold for rotating session files.

methods.name: resolveResetArchiveRetentionMs
methods.description: Resolves the retention period for resetting archive retention.

methods.name: resolveMaxDiskBytes
methods.description: Resolves the maximum disk bytes for session storage.

methods.name: resolveHighWaterBytes
methods.description: Calculates the high water mark in bytes for disk usage based on config and defaults.

methods.name: resolveMaintenanceConfig
methods.description: Loads and resolves the session maintenance configuration with defaults.

methods.name: pruneStaleEntries
methods.description: Removes stale session entries based on configured age threshold.

methods.name: getEntryUpdatedAt
methods.description: Retrieves the updatedAt timestamp from a session entry, or negative infinity if absent.

methods.name: getActiveSessionMaintenanceWarning
methods.description: Generates a warning if the active session is close to pruning or capping thresholds.

methods.name: capEntryCount
methods.description: Limits the number of session entries to the maximum allowed, removing oldest entries first.

methods.name: getSessionFileSize
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the size of the session store file.

methods.name: rotateSessionFile
methods.description: Rotates the session store file if it exceeds size threshold, maintaining backups.
